fichas.title: Parking Spaces and Layouts
fichas.summary: Describes parking-space demarcation and protective stops, compares parallel, oblique, and right-angle parking arrangements, and provides space-requirement and access-width tables. The printed values generally use a 2.50 m parking-space width; bracketed table values apply to a 2.30 m width in justified exceptional cases.
uses: Arranging parking spaces relative to access roads
